title: DIR-011: Complete Replacement of [AI Multi-Provider Engine] with Native FreeLLMAPI Core & Admin-Only BYOK Governance
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Directive ID: DIR-011
Title: Complete Replacement of [AI Multi-Provider Engine] with Native FreeLLMAPI Core & Admin-Only BYOK Governance
Target Project: IME365 (D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365)
Priority: P0 (Critical Production Architecture, AI Engine Overhaul & Enterprise Security)
Executive Engineering Lead: Antigravity (Google DeepMind)
Implementation Engine: Cline / Claude Code CLI

### 1.1 Objective & Context:
User mandates that FreeLLMAPI (located in freellmapi-0.16.6/ as reference) is copied and cleanly implemented inside backend/ with proper structure as the sole, unified AI engine of the platform, completely replacing the existing custom [AI Multi-Provider Engine] (backend/services/aiRouting/).
1.2 Native FreeLLMAPI Capabilities:
All native features of FreeLLMAPI must be preserved and operational:
- Unified OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions engine.
- 34+ providers and 635 endpoints (Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, NVIDIA NIM, Mistral, OpenRouter, Cloudflare Workers AI, Cohere, etc.).
- Multi-strategy smart routing: latency scoring, priority weighting, least-busy.
- Dynamic cooldown probing (cooldown-probe.ts) and automatic rate-limit backoff.
- In-memory LRU + SQLite-persisted response cache (cache.ts) and prompt compression (compression/).
- Multi-key pooling per provider to multiply throughput.
- Live health monitoring & catalog sync (health.ts, catalog-sync.ts).
1.3 Admin-Only BYOK Governance (Managed Concierge BYOK):
- Dedicated tenant BYOK keys must be configured, tested, and managed EXCLUSIVELY in the Super Admin Tenant Management modal (PlatformTenants.tsx / AdminTenantsTab.tsx).
- Credentials encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM envelope encryption (ServerKeyEncryptionProvider in mysqlTenantRegistry.js).
- The Enterprise Dashboard (EnterpriseAiTab.tsx) is stripped of raw editable key inputs and streamlined to show read-only executive status badges ('✓ Enterprise Dedicated AI Active' or 'Platform High-Availability Shared Gateway'), 30-day token consumption ring (AiQuotaRing), and model governance allowlists.
- When an enterprise request executes with X-Tenant-Id, if the tenant has dedicated BYOK keys configured in MariaDB, the gateway client injects the tenant's dedicated keys, strictly isolating tenant inference from the public free pool.
1.4 Grounding & Quality Mandate:
- Grounding verification in aiRuntime.js (extractJson, assertGroundedGeneratedContent, assertNoInventedNumbers) must be preserved with zero regressions.
- FreeLLMAPI model selection must enforce minimum capability thresholds: only route resume/interview generations to models with >= 8B/11B parameters and proven structured JSON adherence (e.g. Llama-3.3-70b, Gemini-2.0-Flash, Llama-3.2-11b).
1.5 10/10 Quality Mandate:
- Reiterate and fix all tests, builds, and linting until 10/10 zero-warning, zero-regression completion is proven.

# SECTION 2 — ABSOLUTE MODE RESTRICTIONS: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE
2.1 PLAN MODE:
- Developer inspects freellmapi-0.16.6/, backend/services/aiRouting/, backend/services/aiRuntime.js, backend/enterprise/mysqlTenantRegistry.js, backend/routes/adminPlatformOperations.js, backend/routes/enterprise.js, frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx, frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseAiTab.tsx, and PlatformTenants.jsx.
- Formulate detailed implementation plan and submit via Bridge CLI.
- No application code modification permitted until formal Lead approval.
2.2 ACT MODE:
- Implement surgical code updates in backend and frontend.
- Execute local static validation (tsc -b, build) and Playwright E2E verification.
- Produce evidence package and request Lead review.

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY AND WORKSPACE VERIFICATION
- Target Workspace: D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365
- Reference source: freellmapi-0.16.6/ in workspace root.
- Verify git status, active branch, and package manifests (backend/package.json, frontend/package.json).
- Confirm backend server is running and MariaDB connection pool is active.
- Confirm legacy reference implementations in src/components/admin/tenants/PlatformTenants.jsx (lines 1558-1650).

# SECTION 4 — NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT INVARIANTS
4.1 Zero Plaintext Secret Leakage: Never expose provider API keys in client state, DOM, logs, or unencrypted database columns. Post-save masking with '✓ Active on server'.
4.2 Strict Tenant Data Sovereignty: Tenant BYOK inference must NEVER touch the public shared free pool.
4.3 Zero Fabricated Data: All AI generation and candidate profiles must bind to authentic backend routes and live LLM providers.
4.4 Fact Grounding & JSON Reliability: aiRuntime.js contracts (extractJson, assertGroundedGeneratedContent, assertNoInventedNumbers) must remain inviolable.
4.5 Performance Budget: Frontend build compiles under 3.0s with zero TypeScript compilation errors. Sub-100ms UI render budgets and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.

# SECTION 5 — TARGET ARCHITECTURE & FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
5.1 FreeLLMAPI Native Engine Inside Backend (backend/services/aiGateway/):
- Port and structure FreeLLMAPI core inside backend/services/aiGateway/ with SQLite store (data/freeapi.db), provider adapters (34+ providers: Groq, Cerebras, Google Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Mistral, OpenRouter, Cloudflare, Cohere, DeepSeek), routing engine, cooldown probe, ratelimit backoff, prompt compression, and LRU cache.
5.2 Deprecation & Replacement of aiRouting/:
- Refactor backend/services/aiRuntime.js to speak directly to the FreeLLMAPI OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.
- Replace legacy aiRouting/orchestrator.js invocations with FreeLLMAPI native calls.
- Pass tenant-specific credentials or profile headers when X-Tenant-Id has dedicated BYOK configured in MariaDB.
5.3 Admin-Only BYOK Governance (backend/enterprise/mysqlTenantRegistry.js & backend/routes/adminPlatformOperations.js):
- Wire ServerKeyEncryptionProvider (AES-256-GCM envelope encryption) into mysqlTenantRegistry.js to encrypt customProviderKeys on save and decrypt on route execution, removing the 501 limitation.
- Add POST /api/platform/tenants/:tenantId/ai-keys/test for live latency reachability testing from Super Admin.
5.4 Super Admin Key & BYOK Control Center:
- Modernize frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx to configure and test FreeLLMAPI master provider keys (Groq, Cerebras, Google AI Studio, NIM, Mistral, OpenRouter, etc.) with multi-key pooling and live latency probes.
- Update PlatformTenants.tsx (or Tenant Edit Modal in Super Admin) with dedicated 'AI Quotas & BYOK Keys' tab matching legacy PlatformTenants.jsx lines 1558-1650 with dedicated keys per provider and live ⚡ Test Connection buttons.
5.5 Streamlined Enterprise Dashboard (frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseAiTab.tsx):
- Remove editable key inputs to prevent client-side credential exposure.
- Render executive Cuba M3 glassmorphic status: Dedicated BYOK status badge ('✓ Dedicated Enterprise Gateway Active' or 'Platform High-Availability Shared Gateway'), 30-Day token consumption ring (AiQuotaRing), and model governance allowlists.

# SECTION 6 — ACCESSIBILITY & UX STANDARDS
- WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance: All modal dialogs must trap focus, handle Escape dismissal, expose proper ARIA attributes, and meet 4.5:1 text contrast ratios.
- Smooth Cuba M3 glassmorphism, no FOUC, responsive layout on desktop and mobile.

# SECTION 7 — SECURITY & DATA INTEGRITY
- Envelope encryption: Master encryption key from process.env.ENTERPRISE_ENCRYPTION_KEY seals data keys.
- Authentication: All AI endpoints guarded with Firebase Bearer tokens and role-based permissions (system.config.write, tenant.ai.manage).

# SECTION 8 — RECOVERY & ROLLBACK
- Changes cleanly scoped to backend/services/aiGateway/, backend/services/aiRuntime.js, backend/enterprise/mysqlTenantRegistry.js, backend/routes/adminPlatformOperations.js, frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx, frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseAiTab.tsx, and PlatformTenants.tsx.
- Git working tree clean baseline.

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
- Layer 1: Static analysis: npx tsc -b in frontend exits 0.
- Layer 2: Frontend build: npm run build exits 0 within budget.
- Layer 3: Backend tests: node --test test/ai-routing-security.test.js and test/ai-model-routing-byok-tenant.test.js pass with 100% success.
- Layer 4: Live E2E test verifying:
  a) Candidate AI generation succeeds via FreeLLMAPI fallback chain (Groq/Cerebras/Gemini/NIM).
  b) Tenant with BYOK routes strictly through dedicated tenant key.
  c) Simulated 429 fails over transparently to next provider with zero error returned to user.
- Layer 5: Playwright browser test verifying Super Admin AI Settings, Tenant BYOK editor, and Candidate Resume Builder generation.

# SECTION 10 — REQUIRED FORENSIC DELIVERABLES
- Implementation Plan (Bridge ledger)
- Git Diff Audit
- Live Gateway test logs & Playwright crawl results

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY & WAVE SEQUENCING
Severity: P0 Critical
- Wave 1: Ingest & structure FreeLLMAPI inside backend/services/aiGateway/ and wire OpenAI-compatible router.
- Wave 2: Refactor backend/services/aiRuntime.js to route all application prompts through FreeLLMAPI.
- Wave 3: Implement AES-256 encrypted BYOK store in mysqlTenantRegistry.js and Super Admin API.
- Wave 4: Modernize Super Admin UI (AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx and PlatformTenants.tsx BYOK modal).
- Wave 5: Streamline Enterprise Dashboard (EnterpriseAiTab.tsx) to read-only SLA & quota telemetry.
- Wave 6: Comprehensive verification gates (tsc -b, build, live failover, Playwright E2E) and reiterate until 10/10 quality.

# SECTION 12 — RESPONSE & COMPLETION REPORT
- Structured exit report with objective verification, file diffs, test logs, and visual evidence.

# SECTION 13 — BRIDGE SUBMISSION SYNTAX
Submit plan using:
bridge dev plan --directive DIR-011 --projectDir "D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365" --summary "<Plan summary>" --steps "<Step 1>;<Step 2>;<Step 3>"

# SECTION 14 — FINAL EXECUTIVE INSTRUCTION
Execute plan mode investigation, verify the actual codebase, submit detailed architectural plan, and await formal Lead approval before modifying application code.
invariants: Zero plaintext API key leakage in client state, DOM, logs, or unencrypted database columns
Strict data sovereignty: Tenant BYOK inference must NEVER touch the public shared free pool
Zero synthetic or simulated verification: all provider tests and browser crawls must use live DOM/APIs
Sub-100ms UI render budgets and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards strictly maintained
acceptanceCriteria: FreeLLMAPI core integrated natively inside backend/services/aiGateway/ as the sole platform AI engine, completely replacing legacy aiRouting/
All native FreeLLMAPI features functional: 34+ providers, smart scoring, cooldown probes, prompt compression, response caching, and key pooling
Super Admin Panel (AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx) manages master keys and multi-key pooling with zero plaintext secret leakage
BYOK is controlled EXCLUSIVELY from Super Admin Tenant Management (PlatformTenants.tsx) with AES-256-GCM envelope encryption
Enterprise Dashboard (EnterpriseAiTab.tsx) has editable key inputs removed and displays read-only SLA badge, quota ring, and model governance
Tenant BYOK requests strictly route through dedicated tenant keys, air-gapped from the public free pool
Fact-grounding (assertGroundedGeneratedContent, assertNoInventedNumbers) and extractJson in aiRuntime.js preserved with zero regressions
All backend tests, builds, and Playwright DOM crawls pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings (10/10 Quality Mandate)

plan.summary: Complete Replacement of [AI Multi-Provider Engine] with Native FreeLLMAPI Core & Admin-Only BYOK Governance
steps: 1. Ingest and structure FreeLLMAPI core inside backend/services/aiGateway/ with unified OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions engine, provider catalog (34+ providers), smart routing, cooldown probing, prompt compression, and response cache

2. Refactor backend/services/aiRuntime.js to communicate directly with FreeLLMAPI gateway, passing tenant credentials when configured while strictly preserving fact-grounding (assertGroundedGeneratedContent, assertNoInventedNumbers) and extractJson

3. Implement AES-256-GCM encrypted BYOK credential store in backend/enterprise/mysqlTenantRegistry.js using ServerKeyEncryptionProvider, removing the 501 limitation and enabling secure tenant key storage

4. Modernize Super Admin AI Settings (frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAiSettingsTab.tsx) to configure master keys across FreeLLMAPI providers with multi-key pooling, latency probes, and zero plaintext secret leakage

5. Implement dedicated Tenant BYOK tab in Super Admin Tenant Management (frontend/src/components/admin/tenants/PlatformTenants.tsx) matching legacy lines 1558-1650 with dedicated provider keys, model selection, and live connection testing
6. Streamline Enterprise Dashboard (frontend/src/components/enterprise/EnterpriseAiTab.tsx) to read-only SLA badges, 30-day token consumption ring, and model governance allowlists
7. Execute comprehensive verification gates (tsc -b, build, unit/integration failover tests, and Playwright E2E crawl), reiterating until 10/10 quality is achieved.
